latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.18
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.18

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.18. The engines (`strata-engine` and the new `strata-hy4` shape engine) are 0.1.64 on every platform, and so is Control, the program that installs and updates them. The update feeds are sequence 130 (shared) and 126 (`linux-aarch64`).

## What changes for you

- **Native Tencent Hy4-Flash support (`strata-hy4` 0.1.64).** Run Tencent's 220B-parameter (12B active, 64B Engram lookup, up to 1M context, text + vision) **Hy4-Flash** locally across Windows, Linux, macOS Apple Silicon, and DGX Spark (`linux-aarch64`).
- **Three Strata Quantization packs (`strata-engine/Hy4-Flash-Strata`)**:
  - **SQ-64** (`129.61 GB` on disk including `Engram-Q8`): runs from **64 GiB of RAM** with an 8, 12, or 16 GiB GPU.
  - **SQ-96** (`157.16 GB` on disk): tuned for **96 GiB** systems (including Olares One and 96–128 GiB desktops/laptops).
  - **SQ-128** (`181.23 GB` on disk): closest to BF16 (`0.0879` reasoning mean KL), for **128 GiB+** systems and unified-memory workstations.
  - **Built-in `DFly2` speculative decoding** and **native Vision (`Hy4-Flash-Vision.strata`, 0.93 GB)** are supported out of the box in both the Desktop app and `strata launch`.
- **15 ready-made `strata-hy4` 0.1.64 packages** in `shape_engines`, fetched automatically on demand when you choose a Hy4-Flash pack:
  - **Windows `x86_64`:** `cuda-cuda13`, `cuda-cuda12`, `hip-strix` (`gfx1151`), `hip-rx9070` (`gfx1200`/`gfx1201`), `hip-rdna3` (`gfx1100`–`gfx1103`), `hip-rdna2` (`gfx1030`–`gfx1032`).
  - **Linux `x86_64`:** `cuda-cuda13`, `cuda-cuda12`, `hip-halo` (`gfx1151`), `hip-rx9070`, `hip-rx7900`, `hip-rx6000`, and unified `sycl` (Intel Arc A-series & Battlemage B-series).
  - **macOS `arm64`:** `metal` (Metal 3 & Metal 4 cooperative tensor / residency sets, signed & Apple-notarized).
  - **Linux `aarch64`:** `cuda-cuda13` (NVIDIA Grace Blackwell / DGX Spark GB10).
- **Update as usual.** Your existing Qwen and DeepSeek models, chats, and settings stay untouched.

## Hy4-Flash engine highlights

- **NVIDIA CUDA (`sm_70`–`sm_120`):** `Tree-8` CUDA Graph capture and replay across all 38 recomputed rows (bitwise-exact match with ungraphed execution), `MLA_CAUSAL` split-K batch invariance, 8-thread `384 MiB` bounce hybrid prefill, dynamic `vcache` sizing, and `AVX-VNNI` (`k2_vnni`) `1.5x` faster CPU cold-expert kernels on Arrow Lake / hybrid CPUs. Up to **240 tok/s** decode (`4,015 tok/s` prompt) on RTX PRO 6000 and **90–111 tok/s** (`1,694 tok/s` prompt at 128K context) on RTX 5090.
- **Apple Silicon Metal (`macos-arm64`):** Metal 4 residency sets + cooperative tensor decode/prefill kernels, reaching **69–110 tok/s** decode (`1,215 tok/s` prompt) on M5 Max 128 GB.
- **AMD ROCm / HIP (`gfx1151`, `gfx120x`, `gfx110x`, `gfx103x`):** native RDNA4, RDNA3, RDNA2, and Strix Halo unified-memory execution (**62 tok/s** on R9700 / RX 9070 XT; **51–60 tok/s** on Ryzen AI Max+ 395 Strix Halo 128 GB), plus Windows `FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING` direct cold-SSD streaming.
- **Intel Arc SYCL (`linux-x86_64-sycl`) & DGX Spark (`linux-aarch64`):** unified fat-SPIR-V Intel Arc package and native Grace Blackwell `sm_121` build (**43.9 tok/s** decode, **924 tok/s** prompt on GB10).
- **Desktop App & Terminal (`strata launch`):** Guided Setup and the Models view show hardware-fit badges for `SQ-64`, `SQ-96`, and `SQ-128`, resume partial multi-part HTTP downloads cleanly, attach missing `Hy4-Flash-Vision.strata` when image support is enabled on an existing text pack, and support mid-stream `Stop` + multi-turn recovery and image tool calls.

## Updating

- **App:** the in-app update offers 0.2.18, or download the installer below.
- **Terminal:** run `strata update`.
- **A clone of the repository:** run `UPDATE.bat` (Windows) or `./setup.sh --update`.

## Downloads

Total: 49 files, 10,026,027,889 bytes.

Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.18-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.18-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.18-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Run **`strata connect`** to see setup instructions for your tool. [Connection guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect). ## Help [All guides](docs) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [Benchmarks](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [Contribute](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Support Strata **Help keep local AI open to everyone.** A GitHub sponsorship or a coffee helps fund development and testing on more hardware. ### Loyal supporters Thank you to everyone who supports Strata.
